flashcard_questions.a: A natural event that threatens people and property.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is a volcanic eruption on an uninhabited island not a hazard?
flashcard_questions.a: It has no potential to cause death, injury or economic loss.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does the wealth of a country affect its hazard risk?
flashcard_questions.a: Richer countries can afford stronger buildings, better warning systems and trained emergency services.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the approximate temperature of the Earth's core?
Which layer of the Earth is liquid metal that generates the magnetic field?
What percentage of the Earth's volume is the crust?
Oceanic crust is ____ km thick, far thinner than continental crust.
What is oceanic crust mainly made of?
Why is oceanic crust forced under continental crust when they meet?
flashcard_questions.a: It is denser than continental crust.

flashcard_questions.q: What drives plate movement according to convection theory?
flashcard_questions.a: Circular currents of rising and sinking magma in the mantle.

flashcard_questions.q: How fast do tectonic plates typically move?
What share of the world's volcanoes lies in the Pacific Ring of Fire?
What share of the world's earthquakes happens in the Pacific Ring of Fire?
Why does the UK have very few earthquakes and no active volcanoes?
flashcard_questions.a: It sits in the middle of the Eurasian Plate, far from any plate boundary.

flashcard_questions.q: Which supervolcano sits above a hotspot in the middle of a plate?

notes: 15 cards: 3 term-to-definition (natural hazard, outer core, convection theory), 5 case-study or figure cards with one figure each (core temperature, crust share, oceanic thickness cloze, 75% volcanoes, 90% earthquakes), 4 cause-to-consequence (uninhabited island, wealth and risk, subduction by density, UK position), 2 process-to-fact (plate speed, basalt), 1 place-to-feature (Yellowstone). Dropped the 3.8-billion-year continental age and the granite card to avoid pairing every oceanic card with a continental twin.
